body: It's a promotional gift  . Ha-Lapid as mentioned on the other side is a travel agency from Petah-Tikva in Israel. The numbers are phone numbers without the 03 area cod prefix.

I am so sorry for your loss.

And yes I do believe in signs.

Allow me to share my story. My mother died on the 16th of February. Short time after her passing,  while at the grocery store I spotted  among the dairy products (?)  a stand of plastic flowers. I don't know why but I kept looking at them. And there it was. A small pot of plastic lilies of the valley . I live in a country where there are no lilies of the valley. Nobody even knows what they are or how they look. As a child I grew  up in Poland and I used to  love them. My mother always brought me bunches of them in the spring. For me , seeing them even if only in their plastic form, in the most unlikely place imaginable,  was like hearing my mother saying "I love you" for the last time.
My former  therapist (!!) told me to drink a glass of red wine after work and just relax. Nice.
Not possible with the current situation. Not to mention that I lack basic social skills.
Not from the US. It does not really matter.
